state_templates: unchanged frozen 0.1.0 input and 18 nonnumeric templates
numeric_border_policy: outer edge only; at least 90pct line; 2 inward blank rows/cols; tight crop unchanged surviving glyph pixels
numeric_resize: isolated border -> native glyph + pad5; no border -> unchanged original input; low numeric score -> native retry with exact text agreement
numeric_structure_guard: ASCII digit length must equal independent ink component count (area>=6); column spans recorded; no boundary touching
acceptance: unchanged threshold; never infer digits from time, other fields or prior values
support: original CAL scale approximately 1.385 only; not independent VAL
